Step.title: Welcome to MCCF

Media.caption: Introduction to MCCF Overview. Presented by len bullard.

Step.Instruction:
Welcome to MCCF. We will learn how to make worlds by making the one in the X3D panel on the left. This panel is the MCCF X3D Viewer with the scene you will build there as a live example. Use it to animate the characters through a series of waypoints in zones. Explore the scene as you follow the steps. The reference panel on the right shows the controls you use to create each layer of the scene. Have fun,
cheers, len

Step.title: In Git Bash, go to your mccf_full folder

Media.caption: Open Git Bash. Set directory locations and start MCCF server.

Step.Instruction: In Git Bash, go to your mccf_full folder and run: py mccf_api.py. Leave the window open.

Step.title: In Edge, open http://localhost:5000/stat
Step.Instruction: In Edge, open http://localhost:5000/static/mccf_launcher.html and select Scene Composer. The status light is green.

Step.title: On the Scene tab name the scene ConeAndC
Step.Instruction: On the Scene tab name the scene ConeAndCamera and set Width and Depth to 40 metres.

Question.title: The scene grid is measured in:
Question.Prompt: The scene grid is measured in:

Step.title: Set Navigation to WALK, the transition t
Step.Instruction: Set Navigation to WALK, the transition to TELEPORT and the transition time to 1 second.

Step.title: Set the sky to a deep blue and the groun
Step.Instruction: Set the sky to a deep blue and the ground to black.

Step.title: In Assets, Assets, place TestObelisk at
Step.Instruction: In Assets, Assets, place TestObelisk at x 21.4, z 16.9. The map shows the 40 m square with the obelisk in it.

Step.Instruction:
Set the types and radii:
Z1 intimate, radius 2. Z2 forum, radius 4. Z3 library, radius 1.5. Z4 threat, radius 4.

Question.title: What does a zone give a place?
Question.Prompt: What does a zone give a place?

Response.text: Its character: weights for E, B, P and S, and a sound

Step.title: Set the E, B, P, S Zone weights
Set the ambient scales: Z1 dorian, Z2 ma
Step.Instruction: Set the ambient scales: Z1 dorian, Z2 major, Z3 aeolian, Z4 pentatonic. The Dashboard lists each zone with its type.

Step.title: Place Agent/Actors
Step.Instruction: In Actors, choose The Witness from the roster and click the map at x 31.05, z 22.55. She appears as a placeholder, a cylinder with a sphere head.

Question.title: Until an avatar is assigned, an actor ap

Media.caption: Two kinds of Agent/Actors. Placeholders and Characters.

Question.Prompt: Until an avatar is assigned, an actor appears as:

Response.text: A cylinder body with a sphere head, about 1.75 m tall

Step.title: Choose Salida from the roster and click
Step.Instruction: Choose Salida from the roster and click the map at x 29, z 20.8.

Step.title: Select The Witness. In the Actor Edit pa
Step.Instruction: Select The Witness. In the Actor Edit pane, under Avatar, choose cindy_hanim.x3d and click Apply.

Step.title: Select Salida, choose Anna.x3d and click
Step.Instruction: Select Salida, choose Anna.x3d and click Apply.

Step.title: Set Avatar Scale
Step.Instruction: Under Avatar scale (this scene), set Salida to 1.5 and click Apply Scale. Export and view the scene in the X3D Loader: both characters appear as avatars, Salida larger than The Witness.

Question.title: Does Avatar scale change the avatar file
Question.Prompt: Does Avatar scale change the avatar file?

Response.text: No, it changes the avatar in this scene only

Step.title: In Assets, Waypoints, place WP1 at x 21.
Step.Instruction: In Assets, Waypoints, place WP1 at x 21.65, z 25.8 (dwell 3). WP2 at 25.8, 20.7 (dwell 5). WP3 at 21.3, 14.7 (dwell 3.5). WP4 at 16.1, 18.0 (dwell 3.5). WP5 at 14.5, 17.1 (dwell 4, zone Z4). Set pace 1.4 on each.

Response.text: How long the actor waits there, in seconds

Step.title: In Paths, make path_witness for The Witn
Step.Instruction: In Paths, make path_witness for The Witness through WP1, WP2, WP3, WP4 in that order. Select WP names in desired order. List appears below selection.

Step.title: Make path_Salida4 for Salida through WP2
Step.Instruction: Make path_Salida4 for Salida through WP2, WP3, WP4, WP5. Both paths are drawn on the map.

Step.title: On the Dialogue tab, at WP1 add: The Wit
Step.Instruction: On the Dialogue tab, at WP1 add: The Witness says "Welcome to the Island." Salida answers "We are here to get you started creating narrative worlds with MCCF."

Step.title: At WP2: Salida asks "Have you created 3D
Step.Instruction: At WP2: Salida asks "Have you created 3D worlds?" The Witness answers "Yes."

Step.title: At WP3: Salida asks "Do you want to use
Step.Instruction: At WP3: Salida asks "Do you want to use the Getting Started PI Course?" The Witness says "The Help PI is a guided instruction application that teaches you step by step how to create worlds in MCCF."

Step.title: At WP4: The Witness says "Let's begin ou
Step.Instruction: At WP4: The Witness says "Let's begin our first lesson." Salida answers "We will teach you how to make THIS world." The Witness asks "Are you ready to begin?" Salida answers "May fortune favor the foolish."

Step.title: In Assets, Cameras, capture eight camera
Step.Instruction: In Assets, Cameras, capture eight cameras. For Salida: CAM_Medium_Salida (29.7, 0.8, 30.4), CAM_CloseUp_Salida_2 (29.4, 1.7, 27.9, jump), CAM_OverShoulder_Salida (29.3, 1.6, 26.6, heading -20), CAM_Profile_Salida (32.7, 1.7, 25.4, heading 90), CAM_Overhead_Salida (33.5, 7, 30.0, heading 40, pitch -47).

Step.title: For The Witness: CAM_Wide_TheWitness (28
Step.Instruction: For The Witness: CAM_Wide_TheWitness (28.5, 3, 37.4, pitch -21), CAM_Medium_TheWitness (28.5, 1.7, 30.4), CAM_CloseUp_TheWitness (27.8, 1.7, 25.8). Each camera shows in the Loader's viewpoint buttons.

Step.title: In Assets, Lights, add white point light
Step.Instruction: In Assets, Lights, add white point lights WP2Overhead (27.6, 4, 24.5), WP3OverHead (21.6, 4, 14.5) and WP5Verhead (15, 4, 16.8), radius 100.

Step.title: Add a red point light WP4Overhead at (14
Step.Instruction: Add a red point light WP4Overhead at (14.2, 6, 19.9), radius 8, and Overhead2 at (29.4, 4, 23.4), radius 10, with Aim at actor set to Salida.

Step.title: Add Spotlight1 (amber, follows The Witne
Step.Instruction: Add Spotlight1 (amber, follows The Witness) and Spotlight2 (white, follows Salida, tick Follow turns). Set Aim at actor on each to the character it follows.

Question.title: What does Aim at actor do?
Question.Prompt: What does Aim at actor do?

Response.text: Points the light at the middle of that actor
Makes the actor face the light

Step.title: On the Export tab tick Standard characte
Step.Instruction: On the Export tab tick Standard character lights. In the Actor Edit pane, Character lights can switch the set on or off for one actor. Both characters are lit in the Loader.

Step.title: In Assets, Audio and MIDI, add the scene

Media.caption: Select and place audio sources in scene.

Step.Instruction: In Assets, Audio and MIDI, add the scene tracks.

Step.title: Add zone sounds: Z1 shankarBharav02.wav
Step.Instruction: Add zone sounds.

Step.title: On the Network tab link Z1 to Z3 with st
Step.Instruction: On the Network tab link Z1 to Z3 with strength 0.6 and couplers R, G and T.

Step.title: On the Export tab untick Name labels and
Step.Instruction: On the Export tab untick Name labels and zone markers. Leave Standard character lights and Standard actor cameras ticked, then Export.

Step.title: Open the X3D Loader, choose ConeAndCamer

Media.caption: X3D Loader with ConeAndCamera.x3d, both characters as avatars

Step.Instruction: Open the X3D Loader, choose ConeAndCamera.x3d and press All. Both characters walk their paths, speak at each waypoint and the zone music changes as they move.
